mapper.update: update PACK_DATA_RECORD set EMPLOYEE_ID = #{EMPLOYEEID,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LOT_CODE = #{LOTCODE,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MATERIALS = #{MATERIALS,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PNL = #{PNL,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, PCS = #{PCS,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, XQTY = #{XQTY,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, DATECODE = #{DATECODE,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LAST_UPDATE_DATE =SYSDATE, STANDARD_CAPACITY = #{STANDARDCAPACITY,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, OUTPUT_HOURS = #{OUTPUTHOURS,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, REMARK = #{REMARK,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where ID = #{ID,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: with temp as ( select LOT.LOTNAME,SUM(PG.GIFTQTY) PACKQTY from PACKGIFT PG left join PRP_LOT LOT on LOT.LOTID=PG.LOTID WHERE PG.DELETEFLAG = 'N' AND pg.giftqty>0 AND LOT.LOTNAME=#{LOTNAME} group by LOT.LOTNAME ) select recordPack.LOT_CODE,NVL(SUM(recordPack.PCS),0) PCS,NVL(SUM(recordPack.PNL),0) PNL,NVL(MIN(temp.PACKQTY),0) PACKQTY from PACK_DATA_RECORD recordPack left join temp on recordPack.LOT_CODE=temp.LOTNAME where temp.LOTNAME=#{LOTNAME} group by recordPack.LOT_CODE
